description: Fork a fresh draft (version+1) from a PUBLISHED version, seeded with its cases — the edit-after-publish path. Edit the new draft with edgegate_update_eval_set, then re-publish. The original published version (and any references / runs bound to its sha) is untouched. Requires workspace write access.

from_version.description: The version_id of a PUBLISHED version to seed the new draft from.

name: edgegate_new_eval_set_version
